4200:
** πορ-ισμός**, ὁ,
**providing, procuring,** τῶν ἐπιτηδείων {{Refs 2nd c.BC+|2nd c.BC: Polybius Historicus 3.112.2}}; **earning a living,** {{Refs 3rd c.BC+|3rd c.BC: Chrysippus Stoicus 3.172; ἐφήμερος π. 1st c.BC: Philodemus Philosophus “περὶ οἰκονομίας” p.44J.; συγγνώμης 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Bellum Judaicum” 2.21.3: _absolutely_, 4th c.AD(?): Manetho Astrologus 4.448 (_plural_)}}; **money-getting,** {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.524d, 92b (_plural_), 136c (_plural_), etc.}}; **means of gain,** {{NT+4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Chaeremon Tragicus cited in 3rd c.AD: Porphyrius Tyrius Philosophus “de Abstinentia - Porphyrii Opuscula” 4.8; δυσὶ π., γεωργίᾳ καὶ φειδοῖ 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Cat.Ma.” 25; π. μέγας ἡ εὐσέβεια NT.1Tim.6.6}}; **means of livelihood,** {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st c.AD: Musonius Philosophus “fragment” 11p.59H.}}
4201:

(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
4204:
** πόρν-η**, ἡ,
**harlot, prostitute,** {{Refs 7th c.BC+|7th c.BC: Archilochus Lyricus 142, 5th-6th c.BC: Aristophanes Comicus “Acharnenses” 527, etc. (Prob.from πέρνημι}} because Greek prostitutes were commonly **bought slaves.**)
4211:
** πορφῠρο-πώλης**, ου, ὁ,
**dealer in purple**, {{Refs|“IG“ Rom. 4.1071 (from Cos), Judeich “Altertümer von Hierapolis“ No. 156}}: _feminine_ **πορφῠρό-πωλις**, ιδος, {{NT+4th c.AD+|“IGRom.” [prev. cited] (probably), NT.Act.16.14, “PFlor.” 71.641 (4th c.AD)}}:—hence **πορφῠρο-πωλική** (i.e. τέχνη), ἡ, **their trade,** [{{Refs 1st c.AD+|AB 379, 1st-2nd c.AD: Harpocratio Grammaticus see at {ἁλουργοπωλική}.}}]
4216:

4257:
** προᾰκούω**,
**hear beforehand,** τι {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 2.5, 5.86, etc.; τῶν ἐνυπνίων 2nd c.BC: Polybius Historicus 10.5.5; περί τινος 4th c.BC: Demosthenes Orator 22.35; προακηκόεε ὅτι.. 5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 8.79}}; προακηκοότες ὡς εἶχε how matters stood, {{Refs|[prev. author] 6.16}}; of a horse, τοῖς ὠσὶ προακούοντα σημαίνειν {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “Institutio Cyri (Cyropaedia)” 4.3.21.}}
4258:
** προᾰμαρτάνω**,
**fail** or **sin before,** {{NT|NT.2Cor.12.21, 13.2}}: _perfect_ _participle_ _passive_, τὰ προημαρτημένα {{Refs 2nd c.BC+|“OGI” 751.10 (Amblada, 2nd c.BC), 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Bellum Judaicum” 1.24.4, 2nd c.AD: Herodianus Grammaticus 3.14.4.}}
4262:
** προβᾰτ-ικός**, ή, όν,
**of sheep** or **goats,** π. χορός a chorus **of goats,** as in the Αἶγες of Eupolis, {{Refs|12th c.AD: Eustathius Episcopus Thessalonicensis 1063.44}}; ἡ π. πύλη the **sheep**-gate, {{LXX|LXX.Neh.3.1}}; without πύλη, {{NT+2nd c.AD+|NT.John.5.2 (nisi to be read π. κολυμβήθρα); χόρτος π. “PGoodsp.Cair.” 30 xxxiv 6 (2nd c.AD).}}
4265:
** προβλέπω**,
**foresee,** ὅτι ἥξει ἡ ἡμέρα {{LXX|LXX.Psa.36(37).13}}; **provide against,** {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Dionysius Halicarnassensis 11.20; λογισμῷ μηδὲν π. Heraclitus Paradoxographus “de incredibilibus - Mythographi Graeci” 11; τῇ ψυχῇ προβλέπειν 4th c.AD: Himerius Sophista “Orationes” 31.1}}; **provide,** θανάτου μνημόσυνον {{Refs|“IG” 12(8).561 (from Thasos)}}:—_middle_, θεοῦ περὶ ἡμῶν τι προβλεψαμένου {{NT|NT.Heb.11.40.}}
4276:
** προελπίζω**,
**hope for before,** {{NT+3rd c.BC+|3rd c.BC: Posidippus Comicus 27.8, 4th c.AD: Themistius Sophista “Orationes” 5.65a; προηλπικότες ἐν Χριστῷ NT.Eph.1.12}}: generally, **anticipate, expect,** {{Refs 1st c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Galenus Medicus 16.822, Dexipp.Hist.32(h) 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus, 6th c.AD: Simplicius Philosophus “in Epictetum commentaria” p.50D.}}
4282:
** προετοιμ-άζω**,
**get ready beforehand,** {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aeneas Tacticus 18.6}}:—_middle_, **prepare for one's own use** or **purpose,** {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 8.24}}:—_passive_, {{Refs 1st c.AD+|[prev. author] 7.22, 1st c.AD: Philo Judaeus 2.252, +others, 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Antiquitates Judaicae” 17.5.6, 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.230e, 3rd c.AD: Philumenus Medicus cited in 4th c.AD: Oribasius Medicus 8.45.7.}}
4283:
** προευ-αγγελίζομαι**,
**bring glad tidings before,** {{NT+5th c.BC+|1st c.AD: Philo Judaeus 1.7, 602, Scholia 5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Trachiniae” 335; τῷ Ἀβραὰμ ὅτι.. NT.Gal.3.8.}}
4293:
** προκαταγγ-έλλω**,
**announce** or **declare beforehand,** {{NT+1st c.AD+|NT.Acts.3.18, 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Antiquitates Judaicae” 2.5.2.}}
4294:
** προκαταρτ-ίζω**,
**complete beforehand,** {{NT+2nd c.BC+|Supp.epigram 4.449.13 (Didyma, 2nd c.BC), NT.2Cor.9.5}}:—_passive_, προκατηρτισμένος **got ready, prepared beforehand,** {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “περὶ εὐσχημοσύνης” 8, compare 3rd-2nd c.BC: Philo Mechanicus “(Belopoeica) Excerpte aus Philons Mechanik - Ath. Berl. Akad.” 95.40.}}
4296:
** προκηρ-ύσσω**,
_Attic dialect_ **προκηρύττω**, **proclaim by herald, proclaim publicly,** {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Antigone” 461, 4th c.BC: Isaeus Orator 6.37, etc.}}: with _infinitive_, π. ὠνεῖσθαι τὸν βουλόμενον {{Refs 5th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “Oeconomica” 1350a20; π. οἱ ἔφοροι κείρεσθαι 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Cleomenes” 9: with _accusative_ _of things_, δρόμον π. 5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Electra” 684; ταῦτα [prev. author] “Ant.” 34; π. στεφάνους τινί 2nd c.BC: Polybius Historicus 5.60.3; π. ἀγοράν 2nd-3rd c.AD: Aelianus “Varia Historia” 4.1}}; **advertise for sale,** κατ᾽ ἀγορὰν τὰ ὤνια {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD(?): Pollianus Epigrammaticus 8.103 (variant)}}; **put up to auction,** γῆν {{Refs 3rd c.BC+|“PEleph.” 23.15 (3rd c.BC)}}:—_passive_, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|“POxy.” 2112.12 (2nd c.AD).}}
